title: Maximize Value of Function in a Ball Passing Game
summary: Given an integer array receiver of length n and an integer k, select a starting player i.
statement: Given an integer array receiver of length n and an integer k, select a starting player i. The ball is passed k times according to the receiver array, and the score is the sum of the indices of all players who touch the ball. Find the maximum score possible. Note that receiver can have duplicates and may include the starting index i.
constraints: Starting at node i, add i and the receiver reached after each of exactly k passes.
Return the maximum function value over all starting nodes.
hints: Powers of two let long pass counts be composed from logarithmically many jumps.
For every node and bit, store the destination and sum of starting nodes over that jump block.
Apply the set bits of k, accumulating block sums, then add the final node.
Binary decomposition covers exactly k edges without overlap, so each visited node is counted once.
editorial: Binary decomposition covers exactly k edges without overlap, so each visited node is counted once.

tests.explanation: Starting at zero follows 0,2,1,0,2 for a total of six.
Trying every start through binary lifting gives the maximum total ten.
